# Contributing

This project welcomes issues and pull requests. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for how to build, test, and what the house rules are.

## Code of Conduct

By taking part in this project you are expected to uphold our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Reporting a security problem

Please do not open a public issue for anything that could expose someone's private data. Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting instead; see the link in the issue template chooser.

## Not affiliated with UNT

This is an unofficial, personal project. It is not endorsed by or affiliated with the University of North Texas. It only changes how the page renders in your own browser. It never touches your account or sends anything anywhere.
